title: We Are Rich
simplified_paragraphs: 从前有一个年轻人，每天抱怨自己没钱。有一天，一个老人路过他的身边，看到他如此颓废，就问："你为什么这么颓废？”年轻人回答：”我没有钱，生活非常糟糕，这让我觉得非常痛苦。”这时老人说：”这简单啊！我花一万元买你的双手，这样你就有钱了。”年轻人愤怒地说：”这算什么办法，别说是一万了，一百万我也不卖。”老人笑了笑说：”你看，你不是很富有吗？你为什么不能像别人那样用自己的双手去创造财富呢？”这时，年轻人恍然大悟，他感谢了老人后就去找了一份工作，并最终改变了自己的人生。
无论我们遇到什么困难，只要我们用积极的方式去思考和面对，事情就有可能变得不一样。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前有一個年輕人，每天抱怨自己沒錢。有一天，一個老人路過他的身邊，看到他如此頹廢，就問："你為什麼這麼頹廢？”年輕人回答：”我沒有錢，生活非常糟糕，這讓我覺得非常痛苦。”這時老人說：”這簡單啊！我花一萬元買你的雙手，這樣你就有錢了。”年輕人憤怒地說：”這算什麼辦法，別說是一萬了，一百萬我也不賣。”老人笑了笑說：”你看，你不是很富有嗎？你為什麼不能像別人那樣用自己的雙手去創造財富呢？”這時，年輕人恍然大悟，他感謝了老人後就去找了一份工作，並最終改變了自己的人生。
無論我們遇到什麼困難，只要我們用積極的方式去思考和面對，事情就有可能變得不一樣。
pinyin_paragraphs: cóng qián yǒu yī gè nián qīng rén， měi tiān bào yuàn zì jǐ méi qián。 yǒu yī tiān， yī gè lǎo rén lù guò tā de shēn biān， kàn dào tā rú cǐ tuí fèi， jiù wèn：" nǐ wèi shén me zhè me tuí fèi？” nián qīng rén huí dá：” wǒ méi yǒu qián， shēng huó fēi cháng zāo gāo， zhè ràng wǒ jué de fēi cháng tòng kǔ。” zhè shí lǎo rén shuō：” zhè jiǎn dān a！ wǒ huā yī wàn yuán mǎi nǐ de shuāng shǒu， zhè yàng nǐ jiù yǒu qián le。” nián qīng rén fèn nù de shuō：” zhè suàn shén me bàn fǎ， bié shuō shì yī wàn le， yī bǎi wàn wǒ yě bù mài。” lǎo rén xiào le xiào shuō：” nǐ kàn， nǐ bù shì hěn fù yǒu ma？ nǐ wèi shén me bù néng xiàng bié rén nà yàng yòng zì jǐ de shuāng shǒu qù chuàng zào cái fù ne？” zhè shí， nián qīng rén huǎng rán dà wù， tā gǎn xiè le lǎo rén hòu jiù qù zhǎo le yī fèn gōng zuò， bìng zuì zhōng gǎi biàn le zì jǐ de rén shēng。
wú lùn wǒ men yù dào shén me kùn nan， zhǐ yào wǒ men yòng jī jí de fāng shì qù sī kǎo hé miàn duì， shì qing jiù yǒu kě néng biàn de bù yī yàng。
english_paragraphs: Once there was a young man who complained every day that he had no money. One day, an old man passing by saw how dejected he was and asked, “Why are you so down?” The young man replied, “I have no money, and my life is terrible. It makes me miserable.” The old man said, “That’s easy! I’ll give you ten thousand yuan for your hands. Then you’ll have money.” The young man said angrily, “What kind of solution is that? I wouldn’t sell them for a million yuan, let alone ten thousand!” The old man smiled and said, “See? Aren’t you rich already? Why can’t you use your hands to earn money, just as other people do?” Suddenly, the young man understood. He thanked the old man, found a job, and eventually changed his life.
No matter what difficulties we face, things can turn out differently if we think about them and face them with a positive attitude.
english_full:
Once there was a young man who complained every day that he had no money. One day, an old man passing by saw how dejected he was and asked, “Why are you so down?” The young man replied, “I have no money, and my life is terrible. It makes me miserable.” The old man said, “That’s easy! I’ll give you ten thousand yuan for your hands. Then you’ll have money.” The young man said angrily, “What kind of solution is that? I wouldn’t sell them for a million yuan, let alone ten thousand!” The old man smiled and said, “See? Aren’t you rich already? Why can’t you use your hands to earn money, just as other people do?” Suddenly, the young man understood. He thanked the old man, found a job, and eventually changed his life.

No matter what difficulties we face, things can turn out differently if we think about them and face them with a positive attitude.
